Subject: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Polaris Tech's inference needs. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps so it's easy to share with the team: 

Summary of discovery
- Primary use case: real-time personalized content generation on web + email (latency target: <200ms P95)
- Current infra: mix of managed endpoints and on-prem GPUs; batch jobs for embeddings
- Key constraints: data residency for EU customers, cost per 1M tokens, and predictable SLA for peak events

What Redwood can help with (high level)- Hosted API for rapid rollout + Dedicated pools for predictable throughput and isolation- Prefix caching and workload-aware batching to reduce per-token cost

Proposed next steps
1) I attached a short discovery recap and a rough pricing example for the profile we discussed (attachment: 20260206-Redwood-discovery-recap.pdf).
2) If this looks reasonable, schedule a 30-min capacity and compliance sync with Sean (cc'd) to talk Dedicated sizing and EU data controls.
3) If you'd like a quick demo of streaming + tool-calling use cases we can include sample prompts and a live run.

Open questions you flagged
- Do you have specific SLA targets for peak traffic windows?
- Is there an internal procurement timeline we should be aware of (Q2/Q3)?

Proposed times for the sync: Mon 2/9 10:00–10:30 PT, Tue 2/10 11:00–11:30 PT — happy to adjust.

Thanks — appreciate the time, and I can prep a short capacity sketch if you want it ahead of the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
